units: Pes. 111ᵇ א׳ דמזוני וכ׳ (Ms. M. שדא, read שרא; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) the genius appointed over sustenance is named Cleanliness.
Ib. א׳ דעניותא וכ׳ (in Ms. our w. omitted) the genius of want is named Filth.
<cite ref="Yoma 77a">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דפרסי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שרא</he>, in a passage omitted in many editions, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) the genius of the Persians (Pharsees).
